dedupe_keys.name: depuradoras de agua residual gestionadas o financiadas por la c a de aragon

description: Depuradoras de agua residual gestionadas o financiadas por la C.A. de Aragón is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gobierno de Aragón. El conjunto de datos contiene información técnica y económica acerca de las depuradoras de agua residual cuyo funcionamiento gestiona o financia la Comunidad Autónoma de Aragón. Coverage: Gobierno de Aragón. The publisher named on the listing is Gobierno de Aragón. Its keywords include Análisis del agua, Agua residual, Estación depuradora, EI2A, Depuración del agua, Agua. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, SHEET, XML. The listing shows 2026-03-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
